outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic paired with western blot images; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows bar charts of densitometry quantification (% FT depletion, log2 elution abundance) with no error bars or indication that bars represent averages across replicates; appears to be single measurements per antibody rather than an average, so individual points are not required.
Panel C is a heatmap of clustered protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D is a violin plot showing the full distribution of enrichment ratios; violin plots are exempt since they already display distribution/spread.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean ± SD (n=4) with individual replicate values overlaid as dots on each bar for Htt, F8a1, and Synj1.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted crystal structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a scatterplot comparing enrichment ratios; scatterplots inherently show individual data points and are exempt from this check.
Panel H is a scatterplot of HTT vs HAP40 abundance across individual IP-MS experiments; scatterplots are exempt.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot; scatterplots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel J shows PCA scatterplots stratified by tissue; scatterplots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
